scorecard.evaluation_scope: POST_HOC_FILTER_AND_DVTA_SELECTION_ON_11D_WINDOW (Base 6-feature L2 Logistic fitted strictly on 2026-09-30..2026-10-21 [n=5,902, pos=292]; AM<=20.0% upper cap and DVTA chart weights selected after inspecting the 2026-10-23..2026-11-06 11-session diagnostic window; True untouched forward validation starts 2026-11-09+)

scorecard.headroom_rule: 1.50% <= am_pct <= 20.00% (>=10%p upside headroom below KRX +30% daily price limit) & am_val_b >= 1.50B KRW
scorecard.dvta_active_formula: dvta_logit = base_oos_logit + 0.015*(dg_reg_d1 + 0.5*dg_prev_d2) + 0.015*(am_vwap_pct * am_vwap_range_pos) - 0.015*(am_fade_pct / max(0.5, log_am_value_eok)) [Note: beta=0.000~0.050 has zero effect on Top 1 (0/11 changed)]
scorecard.return_accounting_basis: DAILY_OPEN_TO_CLOSE_PRICE_PROXY: 일봉 시가(stck_oprc)→종가(15:30) 가격 기준 모의 손익 (-0.25% 비용 차감 · 1분봉/호가 실체결 미검증); 보조지표: D-1 20:00 AM 기준가→익일 15:30 종가 (-0.25% 차감)
